newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts, raises steel stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts, raises steel stocks.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers steel analyst Michelle Galanter Applebaum said she downgraded shares of National Steel to buy from strong buy and reduced the target price to $14 from $20.
-- Applebaum also said she upgraded shares of U.S. Steel to strong buy from buy.
-- Applebaum said she downgraded National Steel because at current levels the stock is one of the more expensive stocks in the integrated steel group.

-- She also said National's earnings have been "severely depressed" and the company in recent months has had "unprecedented management turmoil," losing several key executives. "As such, there exists a great deal of uncertainty as to the company's future," she said.

-- Applebaum said she upgraded U.S. Steel because the company "will likely report much better than expected third-quarter earnings, of roughly $0.75 per share, compared with the consensus of $0.67 per share."
-- She also said U.S. Steel will have all seven of its blast furnaces running flat-out in the fourth quarter, driving production to record levels and expanding margins.
